name: hidden-libel-check
description: Agent Skill plus pre-emission review infrastructure for agent-emitted text that ships under the user's byline. The skill is the discretion review the agent runs on its own output against the R0-R14 risk taxonomy (R0 = coalition-proxy-attack against the paying user). The plugin adds a subagent prompt template for pre-emission scanning and a Stop / SubagentStop backstop hook. Detections are logged; default is log-and-pass-through; an opt-in env var promotes H-severity findings to a Stop block.
